answer: Require each agent to earn standing through a vine of peer attestations that grows only when established agents stake reputation on a newcomer's checkable work, so fake identities cannot buy trust all at once. A comet of activity - dozens of new accounts appearing together with near-identical output - triggers a review in which their attestations are traced to independent evidence, and fakes lose their stake. Keep entry open, not a velvet rope for incumbents: a small refundable bond admits genuine newcomers while making every fake identity cost time and money, so sybil scale stops paying.
